statements.status_notes: pwgen is only used during container initialization to generate random passwords for MARIADB_RANDOM_ROOT_PASSWORD and healthcheck users. It is not used during normal database operation. The CVE relates to predictable password generation under specific conditions, but the generated passwords are immediately consumed by MariaDB and not exposed externally. No upstream fix is available.
